text_block_list.name: Fusaichi Pandora
text_block_list.text:
"Heart-cha~n♪ We're hitting the 
all-you-can-eat cake buffet after school~♡ 
I made suuure to get us a reservation♪"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"Ahaha, looks like veto isn't an option. 
Okay! I'll stick with you to the very 
end!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Dis is big news! De diner in front of de 
station is having a steak fair! We simply 
cannot miss dis!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Sounds great! I was just in the mood for 
meat. Let's enjoy it to the fullest!

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“—With so many invitations like that in a 
row, of course I'd gain weight...”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
“Still, eating it was my own choice. 
Resenting someone else for it would be 
totally nonsense!”

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
"If it goes up, you just bring it down. 
It's as simple as that."

text_block_list.name: Heart's Friend
text_block_list.text:
"Heart, your figure always looks so 
amazing. Do you have a secret or 
something?"

text_block_list.name: Daring Heart
text_block_list.text:
Let's see... Responsibility, and a heart 
steadfast in its resolve, I suppose♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, with her tough heart, Daring Heart 
managed to successfully complete her diet 
without anyone around her noticing.
